title: Książ Lion Gate at Świebodzice
visualBrief: Tall square sandstone piers with broad cornices, seated lions holding shields, rising curved wing walls and open iron leaves; clear sky above the passage.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: +Z toward the park along the adjoining path; sculpture facing provisional
nativeAxes.origin: Mapped gate opening center; Y0 estimated local terrain contact

sourceFacts.primaryDescription: Independent Brama Lwów heritage gate node and adjoining path; exterior interpreted from Irena Goderska’s 2012 primary photograph, not a map-linked photo or surveyed footprint.

reconstruction.basis: Own mapped Brama Lwów node and adjacent path controls; original medium-fi exterior from a 2012 photograph.
reconstruction.scope: One of three park gates in N0291; other site groups remain incomplete.
reconstruction.registration: Path order establishes a native axis, not a verified signed facade or sculpture bearing. No surveyed terrain datum.

geographicProposal.notes: Own mapped gate point and adjoining path axis; no mapped footprint or surveyed dimensions. Signed facing and terrain fit remain unreviewed. Inactive draft.

limitations: One of three park gates; the full N0291 complex remains incomplete.
Map data locates the opening and adjoining path only. Widths, heights and wing-wall curves are photographic estimates.
Exterior follows the 2012 primary photograph. Current restoration state is unconfirmed; present-day activation requires review.
Seated lions, manes, paws, shields and tails are original simplified medium-fi forms without facial likeness, carved heraldry or sculptural microdetail.
No independent Wikidata identifier, unique textures or redistributed reference photos.
Signed facade facing, local datum, terrain fit, adaptive streaming and physical-device timing remain pending.
